scope: Static audit of every Motif ComboBox in Theme Lab forms after the family selector remained on Motif.

findings.risk: These callbacks relied on XmComboBoxCallbackStruct.item_position. Prior Theme Lab evidence records that Motif may report a stale position or one inconsistent with the configured position mode. The intermediate XmStringCompare-only correction also rejected a real selection in the isolated Motif runtime, leaving family_argument=-1 and the project on Motif.
findings.change: Read the committed one-based selection from the ComboBox's internal XmList and convert it to a bounded zero-based model index. Use XmString matching and the configured zero-based callback index only as fallbacks.

findings.path: Generic changed callback schedules model reading after the callback returns; controller reads XmNselectedPosition during its deferred edit/persist/preview path.
findings.assessment: No direct stale callback index found; UI-level behavior still needs a human switch check.

findings.path: Callbacks read XmNselectedPosition synchronously. The piece editor has a code comment that this resource reflects the live list selection in its affected Motif runtime; programmatic relief updates temporarily detach the callback.
findings.assessment: No direct item_position dependency found. Not interactively exercised in this audit.

findings.path: Demonstration control has no selection callback connected to the Theme Lab model.
findings.assessment: Cannot cause the application's family model to remain on Motif.

targeted_integration.first_run: failed: XmStringCompare-only resolver returned no family selection; controller family_argument=-1; saved project remained Motif.
targeted_integration.after_fix: passed: GTK3→Motif→GTK3→Apply→GTK4→Apply→Motif. Apply preserved the selected family in scene/project and all family recipes/visibility masks.
targeted_integration.gtk4_input: Native XmListSelectPos selection with notify=True into the actual ComboBox selection callback; popup pointer placement was not part of this pass.
targeted_integration.scope_limit: Isolated Xvfb/controller integration, not personal-window visual acceptance, pointer popup placement or adapter fidelity.

verification.interactive_selection: The updated build is now open; no selection was injected into the personal window. User visual confirmation remains pending.

next: When the user is ready to reopen Theme Lab, verify family changes Motif→GTK2→Motif and the Paint family/control/state selectors. Then spot-check scheme, state, anchor, scroll part, piece relief and help selectors; keep each result scoped to the exercised widget.
